items.title: 68154_Gus Johnson oral history interview
items.q: I got the teacher, it was a German teacher there, in Omaha, Nebraska. So I took two lessons.

ctx.x: Yeah, it's far from being a rhythm instrument.
Oh, yes. And he had one of the best teachers. He had a German teacher, teaching him violin lessons. But he never learned to play the violin.
He didn't go for it, either.
